features.title: Remote temperature monitoring
features.text: Bring readings from distributed measurement points into the selected monitoring platform.

features.title: Configurable threshold alerts
features.text: Set temperature limits for the application and agree the notification workflow with your platform.

features.title: Probe and range selection
features.text: Family measurement ranges span −200°C to +800°C through selected probe and input configurations. Match the range to your normal and peak temperatures.

features.title: Accuracy options
features.text: ±0.5°C is listed, with ±0.1°C customization available. Agree the accuracy for your working range and complete probe arrangement.

features.title: IP68-rated enclosure
features.text: An IP68-rated transmitter enclosure supports demanding installations. Select the complete probe, cable and connector assembly for the site.

features.title: NFC configuration
features.text: NFC activation and local setup are listed for the family. Match the configuration method to the supplied model.

features.title: Wireless connection options
features.text: Choose a 4G, NB-IoT or LoRa variant for the available network, regional requirements and integration path.

features.title: Low-power operation
features.text: A design reference of over 10 years at hourly reporting under specified test conditions. Match the battery and operating profile to your project.

measurement.heading: Start with the measurement point.
measurement.description: Room air, a pipe wall and the liquid inside that pipe represent different temperatures. Define the quantity you need to know before selecting the probe and fixing its position.

cards.title: Air temperature
cards.text: For rooms, cold stores and equipment air inlets. Position the sensing point where the air represents your monitoring objective, with suitable exposure and separation from local heat sources.
cards.project_brief: Room or cabinet layout · Representative positions · Airflow · Required response

cards.title: Surface temperature
cards.text: For accessible equipment housings, pipe walls and selected surfaces. Specify the contact method, surface material and insulation so the probe measures the intended surface consistently.
cards.project_brief: Surface material · Contact method · Working temperature · Access for installation

cards.title: Immersion temperature
cards.text: For liquids, tanks and process media. Specify the medium, pressure, insertion depth and connection so the sensing element reaches the intended measurement zone.
cards.project_brief: Medium · Pressure · Insertion depth · Wetted materials · Process connection

measurement.installation_heading:
Put the probe at the measurement point.
Put the transmitter where it can operate.
measurement.installation_text: Select the probe for the measured temperature and place the transmitter within its specified electronics and battery operating conditions. Cable routing, enclosure position and wireless coverage are part of the same installation plan.

workflow.heading:
Know the temperature.
Give your team a clear next step.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: The selected probe measures temperature at the defined point. Choose sampling requirements according to how quickly the monitored conditions can change.

steps.title: Transmit
steps.text: Readings travel through the selected cellular or LoRa configuration. Agree the reporting interval and connection path before deployment.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: Use the connected platform to review readings, trends and configured alerts. Define who receives a notification and what action follows.

workflow.platform_text: Connect to Hitelecom Cloud or a compatible customer platform. MQTT is listed in the published specification; confirm message format, authentication and the gateway or server path for the selected wireless variant.
workflow.profile_heading:
Match the reporting profile
to the operation.
workflow.profile_text: Sampling is when the device measures temperature. Reporting is when data is sent. Define both alongside the alert response your team needs, rather than selecting an interval from battery life alone.
workflow.battery_text: The published family is designed for over 10 years of battery life at one-hour reporting under specified test conditions. Actual service life depends on the selected model, battery and sensing configuration, network coverage, retransmissions, temperature, sampling rate and reporting interval.

applications.title: Farmland air & soil
applications.measurement: Shielded air or specified soil-depth temperature
applications.description: Follow temperature at selected crop-air or soil positions across dispersed fields. Local trends give the farming team a record to review alongside crop stage, weather and field operations.
applications.monitoringPoint: Shielded representative air position or a soil-compatible probe at a defined depth.
applications.projectBrief: Crop and soil type, depth, radiation protection, moisture exposure, mounting and network coverage.

applications.title: Orchards & frost monitoring
applications.description: Track temperature through the night at representative orchard positions. Canopy-level and near-ground observations provide local temperature information for the team’s frost-response plan.
applications.monitoringPoint: Radiation-shielded positions near the crop canopy and selected lower areas, with separate points where required.
applications.projectBrief: Crop stage, measurement height, site variation, shield, reporting and notification response.

applications.title: Greenhouses & growing areas
applications.description: Compare temperature inside and outside selected growing areas. Representative crop-zone readings help the team review ventilation, shading and heating conditions through the daily growing cycle.
applications.monitoringPoint: Shielded crop-height air positions, selected greenhouse zones or a compatible growing-medium probe.
applications.projectBrief: Crop height, airflow, sunlight exposure, zone count, humidity exposure, working range and response needs.
applications.measurement: Crop-zone air or specified growing-medium temperature

applications.title: Livestock buildings & yards
applications.description: Observe air temperature in animal housing and selected outdoor areas. Compare local conditions between zones and shifts to support ventilation checks and the farm’s heat- and cold-weather procedures.
applications.monitoringPoint: Representative animal-zone air positions, away from direct heat sources and with outdoor radiation protection.
applications.projectBrief: Animal type, height, ventilation, washdown and dust exposure, mounting protection and reporting requirements.

applications.title: Outdoor weather & microclimate
applications.description: Record local air-temperature trends across campuses, parks and distributed outdoor sites. Consistent exposure and siting help the team compare locations and track changing conditions over time.
applications.monitoringPoint: Shielded air position with suitable ventilation, clear of nearby artificial heat sources.
applications.projectBrief: Measurement height, radiation shield, site exposure, comparison interval, mounting and connectivity.

applications.title: Forests & conservation areas
applications.description: Follow local temperature in forest plots and protected outdoor environments. Relate the readings to the observation site and other environmental information used by the monitoring team.
applications.monitoringPoint: Defined shielded positions within or outside the canopy, according to the monitoring objective.
applications.projectBrief: Canopy exposure, height, environmental protection, access, network availability and any separate humidity or smoke requirements.

applications.title: Solar PV sites
applications.description: Record temperature at selected PV module backsheets, inverter surroundings or site-air positions. Compare the thermal trends with the plant’s operating and weather data when reviewing local conditions.
applications.monitoringPoint: Equipment-approved backsheet contact point, accessible enclosure surface or shielded ambient position.
applications.projectBrief: Measurement objective, approved attachment, electrical separation, cable route, exposure and platform requirements.

applications.title: Wind-power facilities
applications.description: Follow temperature at selected accessible locations in nacelles, towers and electrical rooms. Give remote operations teams a local thermal record to review alongside turbine operating conditions.
applications.monitoringPoint: Equipment-owner-approved air or enclosure-surface points inside the nacelle, tower or auxiliary equipment room.
applications.projectBrief: Operating environment, vibration, mounting, approved access, electrical separation and coverage at the transmitter.

applications.title: Energy storage & UPS environments
applications.measurement: Room air or specified enclosure-surface temperature
applications.description: Monitor air temperature around energy-storage enclosures, battery rooms and UPS equipment. Selected local trends give the facilities team context for ventilation checks and routine equipment inspections.
applications.monitoringPoint: Representative surrounding-air position or separately approved accessible enclosure surface.
applications.projectBrief: Equipment-owner requirements, point locations, electrical separation, room ventilation, mounting and response needs.

applications.title: EV charging sites
applications.measurement: Approved enclosure-surface or control-cabinet air temperature
applications.description: Observe local temperatures around charging equipment and control cabinets. An equipment-approved measuring point provides thermal information for the operator’s installation checks and maintenance review.
applications.monitoringPoint: Approved accessible enclosure surface or representative air position in a suitable control cabinet.
applications.projectBrief: Equipment approval, electrical isolation and clearances, attachment, outdoor exposure, cable routing and response requirements.

applications.title: Electrical cabinets & equipment rooms
applications.description: Follow temperature in suitable outdoor distribution cabinets and indoor electrical rooms. Consistent air or approved enclosure-surface points help the team review ventilation and changes across operating loads.
applications.monitoringPoint: Cabinet air, electrical-room air or an equipment-approved accessible external enclosure point.
applications.projectBrief: Location, electrical separation and clearances, approved access, mounting, cable routing and radio coverage with the responsible electrical team.

applications.title: Telecom sites & outdoor cabinets
applications.measurement: Cabinet, shelter or equipment-surrounding air temperature
applications.description: Bring local air-temperature readings from dispersed base stations, shelters and outdoor cabinets into remote monitoring. Review the thermal conditions around communications equipment and cooling operation.
applications.monitoringPoint: Representative cabinet or shelter air, with the point chosen around the intended equipment environment.
applications.projectBrief: Cabinet layout, airflow, power and radio interference, approved mounting, reporting and local network coverage.

applications.title: Roads & bridge decks
applications.measurement: Specified road-surface, deck-surface or air temperature
applications.description: Record temperature at defined road, bridge and surrounding-air positions. The readings provide local thermal context for winter patrols and maintenance decisions, alongside the authority’s weather and surface-condition information.
applications.monitoringPoint: Engineered pavement or bridge-surface measuring point, or a separately shielded air position.
applications.projectBrief: Surface-probe construction, installation approval, depth or contact, traffic exposure, site power and reporting needs.

applications.title: Outdoor pipelines & heat tracing
applications.measurement: Pipe-wall or specified local process temperature
applications.description: Follow local temperature along selected outdoor pipes, valves and heat-traced sections. Temperature trends help the operations team review cold-weather conditions and the performance of the existing heating arrangement.
applications.monitoringPoint: Defined pipe-wall contact, selected valve enclosure or compatible process measuring point.
applications.projectBrief: Surface or medium objective, insulation, peak temperature, probe contact, weather exposure and any site approval requirements.

applications.title: Outdoor pumps & water facilities
applications.measurement: Equipment surface, water or cabinet-air temperature
applications.description: Monitor selected thermal points around outdoor pumping and water-handling installations. Review local water, equipment and enclosure conditions as part of the site’s operating and cold-weather procedures.
applications.monitoringPoint: Accessible pump housing, compatible water measuring point or approved control-cabinet air position.
applications.projectBrief: Measurement quantity, medium, pressure, materials, installation protection, access and network coverage.

applications.title: Rivers, reservoirs & aquaculture
applications.measurement: Water temperature at a defined location and depth
applications.description: Record water temperature at specified depths in selected rivers, reservoirs and aquaculture sites. Consistent positions allow the team to review seasonal changes and the thermal conditions relevant to the water body or stock.
applications.monitoringPoint: Water-compatible immersion assembly at a defined location and depth, with secured cable routing.
applications.projectBrief: Depth, water chemistry, flow, fouling, cable and connector sealing, access and transmitter position.

applications.title: Cold rooms & freezer storage
applications.description: Monitor selected storage positions to review temperature stability and configured excursions. Use temperature mapping to choose representative locations, including areas influenced by loading, doors and cooling distribution.
applications.monitoringPoint: Representative storage zones, mapped warm and cold locations, selected refrigerator or freezer positions.
applications.projectBrief: Storage temperature band, mapped positions, door activity, probe arrangement and alert response.

applications.title: Laboratories & pharmaceutical storage
applications.description: Monitor refrigerators, incubators and controlled storage used for temperature-sensitive materials. Select the probe, performance and calibration requirements around the stored material and your operating procedure.
applications.monitoringPoint: Selected refrigerator, incubator or controlled-storage positions.
applications.projectBrief: Material storage instructions, working range, allowable tolerance, required records and calibration requirements.
applications.measurement: Specified storage, incubator or sample-representative temperature

applications.title: Refrigerated vehicles & deliveries
applications.description: Follow selected shipment or vehicle temperature points during monitored routes. Specify whether you need compartment air, packaging or a product-representative measurement, and plan connectivity and records around the journey.
applications.monitoringPoint: Vehicle compartment, shipping container, package or agreed product-representative position.
applications.projectBrief: Route, transport duration, measurement objective, coverage, reporting needs and required records.

applications.title: Reefer containers at ports & depots
applications.description: Follow selected temperature points in refrigerated containers at ports, depots and connected transport locations. Define the required cargo or air reading and match the reporting plan to available network coverage.
applications.monitoringPoint: Selected container-air or cargo-representative position, or a separately specified external refrigeration point.
applications.projectBrief: Storage instructions, route and dwell time, network coverage, probe arrangement, reporting and required records.

applications.title: Temperature-sensitive warehousing

applications.projectBrief: Goods and storage requirements, layout, placement, operating hours and reporting needs.

applications.title: Motors & bearing housings

applications.title: Gearboxes & lubrication oil

applications.projectBrief: Surface or oil measurement, oil type, pressure, sealed connection, working range and operating duty.

applications.title: Hydraulic power units

applications.title: Industrial air compressors

applications.title: Food processing

applications.measurement: Selected process-medium, air or surface temperature

applications.title: Process tanks & reactors

applications.title: Industrial chillers & cooling water

applications.title: Industrial water & wastewater
applications.description: Monitor liquid temperature at defined treatment, holding or circulation stages. For temperature-sensitive biological treatment, local trends help the process team review the selected operating conditions and changes between shifts.

applications.title: Data centers & server rooms

applications.title: Occupied buildings & HVAC
applications.description: Measure selected room, supply-air or return-air temperatures to review comfort conditions and heating or cooling operation. Position probes around the measurement objective, avoiding locations dominated by an unrelated local heat source.
applications.monitoringPoint: Representative occupied zone, specified air duct or accessible heating/cooling point.

applications.title: Cleanrooms & controlled production

applications.monitoringPoint: Agreed room-air locations, specified work zones or equipment surroundings identified in the monitoring plan.

applications.title: Concrete curing & construction
applications.description: Track temperature at defined concrete and surrounding-air positions during placement and curing. The temperature history gives the engineering team information to review against the project’s curing plan.
applications.monitoringPoint: Construction-approved embedded probe positions and separately specified ambient points.
applications.projectBrief: Probe and cable suitability, placement depth, point count, installation timing, working range and recording interval.

applications.title: Museums, archives & collections
applications.description: Review temperature trends in selected storage rooms, galleries or display environments against the needs of the collection. For projects concerned with humidity as well, specify a separate or combined humidity-monitoring configuration.
applications.monitoringPoint: Collection-storage zone, display environment or agreed gallery location.
applications.projectBrief: Collection requirements, temperature and humidity objectives, placement, operating events and required records.

applications.title: Historic structures & outdoor heritage

faqHeading.title: Frequently asked questions.
faqHeading.intro: Practical answers for choosing the probe, planning the installation and connecting your temperature data.

faqs.question: How does a wireless temperature sensor work with an external probe?
paragraphs: The probe measures temperature at its sensing point and connects to the transmitter by a probe cable. The transmitter sends readings through the selected wireless connection to the monitoring platform. This arrangement lets you position the probe where temperature matters and mount the transmitter where its operating conditions and wireless coverage are suitable.

faqs.question: How do I choose a probe for air, surface or liquid temperature?
paragraphs: Start with what you need to measure. Air monitoring needs representative placement and exposure; surface monitoring needs reliable thermal contact; immersion monitoring needs suitable insertion depth, materials and a process connection. Share the normal and peak temperatures, required response time and installation conditions so the probe and cable assembly can be selected for the task.

faqs.question: What temperature range can the H Series monitor?
paragraphs: The published H Series family range is −200°C to +800°C. The supplied probe, cable and input configuration determine the range for a particular installation. The probe's measured temperature and the transmitter's surrounding temperature are separate requirements, so choose both around the working conditions of your project.

faqs.question: How should I specify accuracy and calibration for my project?
paragraphs: The published accuracy is ±0.5°C, with ±0.1°C customization available. Specify the accuracy you need over your actual working range, together with the complete probe and transmitter arrangement. If your procedure requires calibration, include the test temperatures, allowable tolerance, certificate and measurement-uncertainty requirements in the quotation brief.

faqs.question: How should I configure monitoring for cold rooms, refrigerators or laboratories?
paragraphs: Choose monitoring points that represent the stored material and operating conditions, using temperature mapping where appropriate. For vaccine-storage projects, assess buffered-probe, recording, alarm and calibration requirements against your storage procedure and current guidance. Share the material's storage instructions and required records so the complete monitoring configuration can be reviewed.

faqs.question: How do sampling and reporting intervals affect battery life?
paragraphs: Sampling determines when temperature is measured; reporting determines when readings are transmitted. Select both around the speed of temperature change and the response you need. The published battery-life design exceeds 10 years at one-hour reporting under specified test conditions. Service life also depends on the selected configuration, temperature, network coverage and retransmissions.

faqs.question: Can temperature readings connect to our own platform?
paragraphs: The published H Series supports Hitelecom Cloud and compatible customer platforms, with MQTT listed for data integration. Specify the wireless variant, regional network and platform requirements. For a LoRa installation, confirm the radio protocol and gateway or server path for the supplied model; the device and backend integration need to be matched as one system.

faqs.question: What should I send for a configuration proposal and quotation?
paragraphs: Send the application, country, quantity, measurement point, normal and peak temperatures, required accuracy and response. Add probe dimensions, cable length, mounting details and any medium, pressure or cleaning requirements. Include the preferred wireless connection, sampling and reporting needs, platform requirements and calibration documents so Hitelecom can review a suitable configuration and quotation.
